episode_summary: Julia Hurley shares her journey from being voted out of a company to building a successful brokerage and athlete management firm. She provides actionable insights on lead generation through open houses and door knocking, emphasizes the importance of resilience, and offers strategies for re-engaging past clients. Her story is a testament to overcoming industry challenges and building a personal brand.
